response.sql: WITH channel_counts AS (SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(e.fillcount) AS average_filled_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS distinct_order_count FROM orderexecutions AS e JOIN orders AS o ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase) SELECT channel, average_filled_quantity, distinct_order_count, CAST(distinct_order_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(distinct_order_count) OVER () AS order_fraction FROM channel_counts
